launches.title: 💬 assistant-ui - Open Source Typescript/React Library for AI Chat
launches.tagline: The UX of ChatGPT in your own app, connected to your own AI agents.
launches.body:
Hi YC! I’m Simon, building **assistant-ui**, an open source Typescript/React library for AI chat.

Hundreds of projects use assistant-ui to build in-app AI assistants, including companies like:

![Logos of LangChain, AthenaIntelligence, Browser Use, Stack AI](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=87644&key=user_uploads/1152943/d3eda556-de8c-4404-b4be-c0295f9aeb8e)

With >50k+ monthly downloads, assistant-ui is the most popular UI library for AI chat.

## **Getting Started**

You can get started by running **\`npx assistant-ui create\`** (new project) or **\`npx assistant-ui init\`** (existing project) in your terminal.

![Gif showing the setup process, which takes under 30 seconds](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=87644&key=user_uploads/1152943/17c78ae1-d8cf-4fc4-a8aa-056fe449da02)

## **Features**

* **Pre-built components**, fully customizable
* **Connects to your backend**
  * We have first class integration for **AI SDK** and **LangGraph** or build your own
* **Generative UI**: Map LLM tool calls and JSONs to custom UI components
* **Frontend Tool Calls:** Let LLMs take action in your frontend app
* **Human Tool Calls:** Human approvals and input collection
* **Chat history and analytics** via assistant-cloud (the hosted offering)

## **Customization**

The API of assistant-ui is inspired by libraries like **Radix UI** and **cmdk**. Instead of a single monolithic chat component, we give you composable primitives and a great starter configuration. You have full control over the look and feel of every pixel while leaving auto-scrolling, LLM streaming and accessibility to us.

![Photo showing the modular component structure. ComposerPrimitive.Input is the chat input field, ComposerPrimitive.Send is the send button.](/media/?type=post&id=87644&key=user_uploads/1152943/d8eacc69-2d94-4c43-8fab-2dcac5e7f029)

Sample customization to make a perplexity lookalike:

![Perplexity lookalike Chat UI](/media/?type=post&id=87644&key=user_uploads/1152943/16e96ae2-d563-4f6c-9047-6c3485a1cb3d)

## **Demo Video**

[Demo Video](https://youtu.be/9eLKs9AM4tU?si=jm9GzoFAcyM_tPT-)

## **About**

I’ve wanted to build my own dev tool company since high school. Last year, I built the first version of assistant-ui because I needed the UX of ChatGPT in my own app. The app I was building didn’t work out, but few friends asked me about the chat UI. Since then, AI chat has became increasingly popular as a means for delegating tasks to AI agents. My focus is on enabling human <> agent collaboration through better UX and AX (agent experience).

![Photo of Simon, the founder](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/media/?type=post&id=87644&key=user_uploads/1152943/d43c8332-b160-40d8-8f27-849bd82806e3)

## **Ask**

* [Check out example demos](https://www.assistant-ui.com/)
* [Star us on GitHub](https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui)
* [Join our Discord](https://discord.com/invite/S9dwgCNEFs)
* [Book a sales call](https://cal.com/simon-farshid/assistant-ui)

name: RowFlow
long_description:
RowFlow replaces clunky web forms with natural conversations that run over text, slack, or wherever your users are. Our platform increases your form’s response rates while cutting your internal overhead in half. 

With RowFlow, you can take any existing form and instantly convert it into an AI-powered conversation. New flows launch in minutes and reach respondents over your preferred channel or embedded chat. We guide the exchange, follow up automatically, and return clean structured data without extra work from your team.

Forms power billions of business interactions yearly. Whether it’s forms for client intake, registrations, compliance, feedback, or surveys, they all follow the same painful pattern: low conversion, messy data, and frustrated users. Teams have long tolerated forms only because there's been no scalable alternative for collecting structured information from people - until now. Our goal is for RowFlow to become the new default way for how organizations collect user data in an AI-first world.

launches.title: RowFlow: Turn any form into an AI conversation
launches.tagline: We replace clunky webforms with AI conversations that get more responses faster
launches.body:
**Hey all -** we’re Jack and Alec, co-founders of **RowFlow**.

**TL;DR**

RowFlow can take any existing static form and instantly convert it into a dynamic AI-powered conversation. New flows launch in minutes and reach respondents over text, Slack, embedded chat, or wherever your users are. We guide the exchange, follow up automatically, and return clean structured data without extra work from your team. Compared to traditional webforms, our AI-native approach delivers higher completions, less overhead, and a better user experience.

**Want to see it in action? [Try our demo here.](https://rowflow.ai/)**

**Have a form that users hate filling out? [Schedule a call with us here.](https://calendly.com/rowflow/discovery-call)**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=93357&key=user_uploads/2767809/755cae46-1c7f-4e48-a9e2-733e1d68348b)

**Problem**\
Forms suck. They power power billions of business interactions yearly _(think: lead qualification, customer onboarding, client intake, feedback forms, surveys, event RSVPs, registration forms, compliance, healthcare…the list goes on),_ but most have:

* **Low conversion:** too many users provide half-answers or drop off before completing.
* **Time drain:** teams waste hours building complex logic, chasing non-responders, hand-holding, and cleaning messy data.
* **Poor user experience:** even when forms do work, they frustrate users and hurt your brand.

Teams have been forced to tolerate these pain points as there's been no scalable alternative for collecting structured information from people - until now.

---

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MrchVB7RHmg

\
**Solution**\
With RowFlow, we abstract away from the static form structure altogether. It works like this:

1. Say what data you need ([or try our Google Form converter](https://rowflow.ai/)).
2. RowFlow runs guided AI conversations over text, Slack, email, or embedded chat with automated follow-ups.
3. You get clean, structured data delivered into your systems.

Our goal is for RowFlow to become the new default way for how organizations collect needed user data in an AI-first world.

---

**Ask:**

1. Do you have a form with low response rate? If so, we’d love to help - [**you can book a call with us here**](https://calendly.com/rowflow/discovery-call)!
2. If you have to fill out a form in the wild that makes you go 🤬, send a screenshot to [**jack@rowflow.ai**](mailto:jack@rowflow.ai) and we’ll take it from there.

\
**About Us:**

Jack and Alec met as freshmen at UPenn and we always knew we’d build something together. 12 years later, we are! Prior to RowFlow, Jack scaled Ops at Uber, Shef, and Faire, while Alec was a quant trader at Virtu and an engineer at Meta.

launches.title: Linzumi: team chat for directing AI coding agents
launches.tagline: Team chat for directing dozens of AI coding agents
launches.body:
# Hi everyone, I'm Sean, and I’m launching Linzumi today

**Linzumi is the team chat your engineering team uses to direct dozens of AI coding agents at once.** Kick off work, review it, ship it: all from chat. Try it at <https://linzumi.com>.

> For a limited time, every team chat account also gets free daily access to state of the art open-weights intelligence, GLM 5.2 at high speed, through our partnership with [Wafer.ai](http://Wafer.ai).

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EM53ACaIHyg>

## The problem

The bottleneck in software has moved. Execution is basically free now: AI agents can write, test, and ship code 24/7. _The new constraint is human decisions and verification_. Whoever surfaces the right decision to the right person at the right moment unlocks 10x throughput. Whoever doesn't watches their agent fleet stall.

If you've ever tried to keep three coding agents productive at once, you know the feeling. You jump between PR tabs, miss approvals buried in Slack, and find one agent has sat idle for 20 minutes waiting on a one-line decision. It's a fascinating moment to be building software: vastly easier and vastly harder at the same time.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=103435&key=user_uploads/19683/9019e12e-5088-4b41-9321-28a417dade5a)

## How Linzumi works

Connect your machine, kick off work in chat, and review what every agent is doing from your laptop, your phone, or the coffee line. Works with Codex today, Claude Code coming soon. Your teammates see it all too: agent work is no longer buried in invisible terminals.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AQP5tQGZ9Jc>

But the real unlock is underneath. As your team works, Linzumi keeps every decision close to the work itself: what to build, why it changed, who approved it, and what the agents should do next. The decision inbox surfaces only the calls that need a human, so instead of reconstructing context from terminals, PRs, chats, and memory, your team has one shared place to steer the whole fleet.

_Continuous Context Compilation_

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TNJbWKYiDyc>

## Backstory

I'm a 3x YC founder. Before Linzumi I was at OpenAI on post-training and alignment research, where I worked on systems for making models follow written specs and produce more reliable reasoning. Working with coding agents on my own projects showed me the same kind of coordination problem at the team level: the agents could execute, but the bottleneck was deciding what should happen next and checking whether the result matched intent.

The mission now is to make everyone the CEO of their own 1,000-agent company: able to direct more work, make better decisions, and become the best version of themselves as a builder.

When you combine that shared context with calibrated decisions, even the smallest form factor can do surprising amounts of work, like shipping a customer feature from your phone on the way to the meeting.

_Hands-free work_

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pmqf3kwuOqI>

## What we're asking for

If you run AI coding agents (or want to), try Linzumi at <https://linzumi.com>. It's free to get started and we'd love your feedback.

We're especially looking for:

• Engineering teams running multiple coding agents who want to scale to dozens (honestly, thousands by end of year)

• Founders who feel like the bottleneck in their own dev cycle

• Anyone curious about better human-agent coordination for company-scale work

DM me on X (@sgrove) or email [sean@linzumi.com](mailto:sean@linzumi.com). I read every reply.
